style: Say in a relaxed, friendly way, like a kind dad helping with homework.
lines: This is a safety sweep. In every room, look for things that could hurt someone. Tap anything that looks risky.
Tap a room to start your safety sweep.
Search the room. Tap anything that looks risky.
You found one. Read what is going on, then tap Think.
Do you need a grown-up first? Tap one of the two buttons.
Tap What could happen to peek at any choice. Then tap the safest one.
That could go wrong. Read what could happen, then choose again.
That’s the safe choice. Now tap Check.
Now do the fix. The hint shows what to drag or tap.
Who is safer now? Tap everyone it helps, then tap Done.
That one looks fine. Keep searching.
Room swept! Tap House, then pick another room.
The whole house is swept and every room is lit. Here is your safety card.
Poison Help is one eight hundred, two two two, one two two two. For a fire, get out, stay out, and call nine one one from outside.
